# Language on the Move

> A multilingual research hub exploring language migration, intercultural communication, and linguistic diversity in the context of globalization and social justice.

Language on the Move is an international research platform led by Ingrid Piller at Macquarie University that combines academic research, podcast content, and community engagement around multilingualism, migrant experiences, and language education. The site hosts original research, video interviews, open-access theses, and annual conferences connecting scholars and practitioners studying language in motion.

## Key Topics

- Multilingualism
- Language migration
- Intercultural communication
- Linguistic diversity
- Language learning
- Migrant settlement
- Language research
- Podcast platform
- Language mobility
- Social justice
- Literacies
- Digital mutual aid
- Japanese language
- Language and identity
- Globalization

## Core Resources & Publications

- [Language on the Move](https://languageonthemove.com): Homepage covering multilingualism, intercultural communication, migration, and social justice
- [Life in a New Language](https://languageonthemove.com/life-in-a-new-language): Book by Ingrid Piller on language migration and migrant settlement experiences
- [Japanese on the Move](https://languageonthemove.com/japanese-on-the-move): Video interviews on transmigration and life stories of Japanese migrants
- [Next Generation Literacies](https://languageonthemove.com/next-generation-literacies): International research network on multilingual education and linguistic diversity

## Research & Academic Content

- [Our PhD Hall of Fame](https://languageonthemove.com/phd-theses): Open-access repository of PhD and MRes theses on multilingualism and migration
- [Blog](https://languageonthemove.com/blogpage): Blog hub featuring summer school, conferences, and language education research
- [Intercultural Communication](https://languageonthemove.com/intercultural-communication-2): Podcast episode reviewing intercultural communication textbook with Dr Loy Lising

- [Language on the Move 2025](https://languageonthemove.com/language-on-the-move-2025): 2025 annual conference archive on multilingual communication and linguistics

- [Language on the Move 2019](https://languageonthemove.com/language-on-the-move-2019): 2019 annual archive with podcast, Japanese language, and multilingual studies
